title: A favourite idea meets a detail
meaning: Practical experiments can help your shared understanding grow, although a pleasing explanation may become emotionally difficult to release.
text: A pleasing explanation can feel especially convincing once it has a visible form. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests investigating through making: drawing a sketch, assembling a trial version and looking at the result. The Empress in energy supports a different contribution, the wish to develop a fruitful idea and let shared understanding grow through experience. The Devil in emotions describes attachment to a version that already brings pleasure. You may like your answer so much that even a small correction feels like losing something personal.

For example, you are planning a shared room and gathering an attractive collection of pictures. It helps reveal the light and atmosphere you enjoy. **A favourite idea stays alive while an awkward detail can sit beside it.** A trial drawing shows that your chosen table would block the passage. This observation can refine the intention while preserving what first drew you to the photographs: a feeling of space. A correction can become a continuation of the thought you began together.

The difficulty starts if attachment to the collection turns every mismatch into something to explain away. You are still discussing the room, but increasingly seeking confirmation of a beloved image. Creative interest retains its strength when the actual subject remains available, including its limits. Letting one detail go then leaves room for the idea to develop beyond the first beautiful form you found.
